requirements.text: Design, train, and deploy deep learning models for computer vision using PyTorch, focusing on real-time object detection and spatial awareness.
Maximize model inference speed and guarantee low-latency performance on edge hardware utilizing CUDA and TensorRT.
Seamlessly integrate advanced computer vision models for perception and navigation for robots, drones, unmanned systems, swarms, etc.
Manage, scale, and maintain containerized edge deployments across distributed hardware using Docker and Kubernetes.
Drive automated data insights and high-performance edge computing initiatives to deliver measurable accuracy gains and operational efficiency in complex, high-speed field environments.
Technical depth in ML/AI with a preference for computer vision and robotics.
Preference on experience in modality including EO/IR, Acoustic / SONAR, RF / SAR.
Proven contributions, whether in industry or academia, that moved innovative ideas closer to product. 3-5 years industry experience
US Citizen requirement due to nature of our projects.
